answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The first ripple of coordinated fakery trips detection, keeping real judgment the scarce resource an attacker cannot simply buy. Tending a falcon, watching a quartz, and naming a walnut is the rhythm of earning trust — deliberately, repeatably, and never in bulk.
